title: chrysothamnus parryi subsp. affinis
intro: Chrysothamnus parryi subsp. affinis, commonly known as California or Rocky Mountain sage, is a perennial shrub native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Chrysothamnus parryi subsp. affinis include its ability to soothe respiratory issues, reduce fever, and promote wound healing, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
